back: A rite that Christians believe is an outward sign of God's grace.
The sharing of bread and wine in memory of the Last Supper; also called the Mass, Holy Communion or the Lord's Supper.

front: Name the seven sacraments of the Catholic Church.
back: Baptism, confirmation, Eucharist, reconciliation, anointing of the sick, marriage and ordination.

front: Which two rites do most Protestants keep?
Which passage gives the baptismal formula?
back: Matthew 28:19: in the name of the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit.

front: How do infant and believers' baptism differ?
back: Infant baptism: babies, with promises by parents and godparents. Believers' baptism: a personal declaration of faith, usually by immersion.

front: How do Catholics and many Protestants differ on the Eucharist?
back: Catholics teach that the bread and wine become the body and blood of Christ; many Protestants see them as a memorial.
A service held some time after burial, when the gravestone is revealed and the dead person is remembered.

front: What does a Christian funeral express?
back: Thanks for the life of the person, comfort for the bereaved and hope in the resurrection.
